items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/optimism in weekend summary then confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders after calf issue; Schefter/Rapoport corroborated official active status and prior optimism.
items.why: Calf improved, pregame clearance; played 8/10 for 68 yds TD.
items.implication: WR1 locked in with Adams out long-term; high target share expected ROS.
items.opportunity: Primary route runner and red-zone option in thinned Rams WR room.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/pessimism in ETR summary; Rapoport said unlikely then officially INACTIVE (quad, 4th straight miss). Allen continues as lead back.
items.why: Limited practices only, early for full return per Rapoport.
items.implication: Misses another week; target Week 8 return vs Raiders.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/lead back volume to Braelon Allen (not listed).

items.text: Christian McCaffrey mild hamstring strain (Shanahan); pretty optimistic for Week 9 post-bye vs Raiders. Returned to prior game briefly.
items.why: Mild per coach; bye helps recovery.
items.implication: Likely misses Week 8 or limited; strong for Week 9.
items.opportunity: If out, 49ers RB committee (Gainwell etc) elevated short-term.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide: Levitan 'almost certainly fine'. Would have been tilting if injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide, no major indication of issue.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY in ETR summary; Schefter confirmed ACTIVE for MNF. Post-game: hamstring 'came out great', back tweak not expected to sideline him.
items.why: Cleared after prior hamstring; pitch count but efficient. Post: hamstring fine, back minor.
items.implication: RB1 continues; monitor back for Week 8 but optimistic.
items.opportunity: Goal-line and volume lead when healthy.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in ETR weekend injury summary (ankle). Coach notes working hard, decent spot for Week 8 possible but more info Wed.
items.why: Ankle; confirmed out for weekend slate.
items.implication: Ravens QB streamer needed; Jackson return watch Week 8.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and pass-catchers adjust; Henry still lead RB.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT per ETR summary. Berry noted slot opportunity (Lemon) vs Cowboys secondary.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thinned; Goedert/others elevated targets.
items.opportunity: Slot/underneath volume to available WRs/TEs; Berry bet Lemon o40.5 yds.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN in ETR summary; returned and Berry discussed ROS fantasy value post-return.
items.implication: Packers RB1 back; Berry ROS discussion positive but committee watch.

items.text: Matthew Berry: 'Can we PLEASE put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name?' calling for upgrade/recognition.
items.why: Production and role warrant more respect in rankings/start decisions.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR2/flex; Burrow connection strong.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst efficiency runner (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) but fantasy RB13 PPR via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume and RZ/target share trump efficiency for fantasy scoring.
items.implication: Continue starting as RB2/flex; touchdown and PPR dependent.
items.opportunity: 9 HVT inside-5 + 45 targets = elite opportunity despite bad running.
items.conflict: Efficiency data poor vs fantasy production.

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; Berry advises turning big game into sell-high opportunity if possible.
items.why: Explosion likely outlier; sell while value peaked.
items.implication: Trade for more stable asset; not long-term RB1 lock.

items.text: Texans routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (clear lead), Tank Dell only 6 in first game back since 2024; Noel 15 (left early turf toe).
items.why: Collins dominated routes; Dell limited return.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell handcuff/stash only until ramp-up.
items.opportunity: 24 routes = alpha target share for Collins.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes (lead) on 36 Mahomes dropbacks in 2nd game without Rashee Rice; note he has never topped 83 rec yds in 37 career games.
items.why: Clear route lead with Rice out (hamstring).
items.implication: Volume WR3/flex with ceiling limited by historical yds; monitor if Rice returns.
items.conflict: High routes but career yd ceiling note.

items.text: Cam Skattebo: Levitan thinks actually hurt (hamstring) but uncertain; listed on ETR Sunday watching list with Tracy.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Tracy or others could benefit if out.
items.opportunity: If out, NYG RB committee opens.
